title: Model
description: A fitted model for one (peril, response) pair. Immutable once fitted. See 02-modelling.md §4.8.
$comment: Amended 2026-08-22 (W5, the contract-reconciliation slice). `fit_result` was one flat object written for the GLM arm alone: it required `converged`, which `GbmFitResult` and `EbmFitResult` do not have, so no GBM or EBM fit could validate against the published contract, and it omitted `booster_format`, `base_margin` and `best_iteration`, without which a booster cannot be scored. It is now three `if`/`then` arms on `fit_result.model_type`, mirroring the discriminated union the code has always returned. Also resolved, each the code's (CLAUDE.md §0): `dataset_version_id` is declared at last — it is required on `Model` and appeared in no `properties` block at all; `Coefficient.exposure_years` is deleted, having never existed on the type; `relativity` becomes nullable, which §4.8's dated amendment records as the fix to a real defect (`exp(β)` reported as 1.0 under a logit link) whose pre-fix shape this contract was still publishing; `monotone_constraint_vector` takes the name the fit result actually uses; `covariance_blob` is a BlobRef, not a string; and `flags` keeps only `dataset_invalidated`, the one value FR-MODEL-67 names and `ModelFlag` defines.

dataset_version_id.description: The Dataset Version this model was fitted on. Required, and undeclared here until 2026-08-22.

fit_result.description: What the fit returned and the Model stores (ADR-0003) — data, never a pickled estimator. Discriminated on `model_type`; the three arms are below.

relativities.description: FR-MODEL-21's relativity table per categorical Factor, with the base level marked.

dispersion.description: The scale parameter φ. Estimated for Gamma, Gaussian, inverse-Gaussian and Tweedie; fixed at 1 for Poisson and binomial.

covariance_blob.description: FR-MODEL-63's covariance matrix V, content-addressed rather than inline: it is p×p, and only the prediction path reads it. Absent on every Model fitted before the field existed, which FR-MODEL-93 surfaces as a typed `covariance_not_stored`.

tweedie.description: FR-MODEL-22: set when the spec requested profile-likelihood estimation of the power. Null under a fixed-power spec.

offset_model_ref.description: FR-MODEL-24: the resolved, pinned ref an offset-from-another-model fit was constructed against. Null for every other offset kind.

booster_blob.description: Backend JSON/text model format only; pickles are refused (ADR-0003, FR-MODEL-31).

booster_format.description: ADR-0003. `pickle` is not a refused value here — it is not a value.

feature_dtypes.description: FR-MODEL-31's dtype expectations, one per feature and checked against `feature_order`: a scoring frame built from a partial map has a column whose type nobody declared.

categorical_maps.description: FR-MODEL-32's encoding maps, per categorical feature.

monotone_constraints.description: FR-MODEL-28, positionally aligned with `feature_order`. Empty when the spec asked for none.

base_margin.description: FR-MODEL-71, and required: the exposure offset the fit was actually constructed with, so the load-time assertion has something to assert. Omitting it at scoring time fails silently on both backends, and differently.

best_iteration.description: Kept on the fit and not in the diagnostics: `predict_gbm` needs it to score, and diagnostics are not loaded at scoring time. The evaluation curve went the other way.

inverse_link.description: The inverse link `predict_gbm` must apply to the raw score itself, or null where the booster's own `predict` already returns the mean. Not the model's link: the two are different claims, and the answer differs by backend and objective.

dropped_eval_metrics.description: FR-MODEL-111. Empty on every fit that evaluated everything it was asked for; populated only where LightGBM early-stops on a Custom Metric and its declared builtins are suppressed so they cannot take position 0 and drive the stop.

then.description: FR-MODEL-37. The fit result IS the model: scoring reproduces `intercept + Σ term scores` exactly, each term a lookup against its feature's bins, so there is no booster blob and no serialised estimator to version.

bins.description: Positional against `feature_order`: bin i belongs to feature i.

items.description: Corrected 2026-08-22: EbmTerm requires bin_weights and standard_deviations and this contract marked them optional, so a client building a fit_result from the published contract omitted them and had the request refused naming a field the contract said was not needed.

term_features.description: Indices into `feature_order`. Two entries make the term an interaction, and its tables two-dimensional.

transparency_artifact_id.description: DECLARED AND UNBUILT (FR-MODEL-87, owner W5). `Model` carries no such field. FR-MODEL-96 (built 2026-08-19) made the reference run the other way — `TransparencyArtifact.model_id` — and R3 is enforced by query at model submission, so whether this back-pointer is still wanted is an open question rather than a gap to fill.

custom_objective_ref.description: DECLARED AND UNBUILT (FR-MODEL-87, owner Phase 1b). A custom objective on the GLM arm needs `GlmSpec.custom_objective_ref`, which is absent entirely; a GBM names its objective through `spec.objective` instead.

change_reason.description: UNRECONCILED (W5, 2026-08-22): this contract has always declared a closed set, and `Model.change_reason` is an unconstrained `str | None`. The enum is kept as the documented vocabulary — refit_new_data, respecified, rebanded, regrouped, hyperparameter_change, objective_change, bug_fix — but nothing enforces it; see CLAUDE.md §0.

flags.description: FR-MODEL-67, and computed from the referents rather than stored: a stored flag goes stale the moment `01` re-validates the dataset version. `objective_deprecated` and `attestation_overdue` were declared here from Phase 0, are named by no requirement and defined by no type, and were deleted on 2026-08-22.

invariants: status in {fitted, review, approved} implies diagnostics_id is set (FR-MODEL-64)
fit_result.model_type != 'glm' and status == 'approved' implies a transparency artifact names this model (02 R3, FR-MODEL-89 — enforced by query at submission, not by a column here)
custom_objective_ref set and status == 'approved' implies that objective version is approved (02 R4)
booster_blob present iff model_type in {xgboost, lightgbm}
fit_result.model_type == spec.model_type — neither discriminator can see the other, so the Model asserts the pairing

Coefficient.description: One fitted term, with the uncertainty 02 R5 requires of every estimate. Single-sourced here; `transparency-artifact.schema.json` references it rather than restating it.

relativity.description: exp(estimate) under a log link — the number an actuary reads. Null where the link is not multiplicative: reporting 1.0 for a logit model said 'no effect' for a factor spanning eighteen log-odds (§4.8, amended 2026-08-15).

RelativityLevel.description: One level of a categorical factor, as an actuary reads it (FR-MODEL-21).

TweediePowerFit.description: FR-MODEL-22's estimated power, its profile-likelihood interval, and the persisted curve.

EbmTable.description: A term's per-bin table: one dimension for a univariate term, two for an interaction.
